factor_name: Volatility-normalized relative 3-day shock reversal with 60-day drawdown gate

calculation.description: Ranks assets higher after short-term underperformance versus the cross-sectional median, normalizes by recent volatility, and sharply dampens exposure to assets in severe 60-day drawdowns. All observations are available at decision time through the prior completed day.

validation.regime_notes: 2025-26: IC 0.04695, ICIR 0.18985 over 103 observations; 2027-28: IC 0.03546, ICIR 0.13456 over 521 observations; recent 252 observations: IC 0.03813, ICIR 0.14934, hit ratio 0.5833. Early 2020-24 regime was not separately reported by the script because the available aligned index began later; interpret uncertainty conservatively.
